basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Pharmacist is on Thursday 12 November 2026, with reporting from 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. at 3rd floor, Meeting Room, PS-306, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210. The employer is A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd., an outsourced contractor for manpower services, which is looking for a Pharmacist to be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC. This is a contract job through a private contractor, with consolidated pay of ₹ 26,630/- p.m. to ₹ 35,000/- p.m.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruitment
content_sections.text: A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. describes itself as an outsourced contractor for manpower services. The Pharmacist will be placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre-ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. The notice is signed by a Supervisor.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applicants for one post, Pharmacist. The qualification and experience are given below as printed. Post registration one year experience in a hospital/ Dispensary is essential. Experience of working on computerized system is desirable. Up to 30 Years (may be relaxed on experience basis). The notice does not print a date for counting age. The consolidated salary is ₹ 26,630/- p.m. to ₹ 35,000/- p.m., decided on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria. The duration is 6 months (Extendable as per requirement). Candidates should check the official notification for any further details on eligibility.

content_sections.text: Candidates should be prepared to work on call as well as in shift duties including night shifts. The post is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. faq.question: Q1. When is the ACTREC Pharmacist walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on Thursday 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Reporting time is 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at 3rd floor, Meeting Room, PS-306, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: HSC plus 2 years Diploma in Pharmacy and 3 months training in Pharmacy, with Central or State Pharmacy Council registration and an allotted Registration Number. One year of post-registration experience in a hospital/ Dispensary is essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 30 Years, and it may be relaxed on experience basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is ₹ 26,630/- p.m. to ₹ 35,000/- p.m., depending on experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: Bio-data, a recent passport size photograph, scanned copies of Aadhar Card and PAN Card, and ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of the qualification mark sheet, certificates and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Pharmacist post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is on contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd. for 6 months, extendable as per requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Will the Pharmacist have to work night shifts?
faq.answer: Candidates should be prepared to work on call as well as in shift duties including night shifts.
